_note: Per-holiday flavor for the HOLIDAY block (scripts/us_holidays.py). dan_traditions are FICTIONAL, like dan_stories.json: Dan's family and friends, never a sports fact. boston_color is real local custom kept qualitative (no dates, scores or player names). A real game belongs in historical_facts.json holiday_games, never here. Keys match us_holidays.py. Holidays with a 'respectful' tone deliberately carry no dan_traditions: no jokes or fictional bits on those days.
